description: Stytch provides passwordless authentication, multi-factor authentication (MFA), and identity management APIs designed for modern SaaS applications. Developers can integrate email magic links, SMS/OTP, OAuth, biometric authentication, and session management without building auth infrastructure from scratch. The platform targets product teams that need secure, customizable login flows with developer-friendly APIs and SDKs.
